blocked_when: Control test is absent or non-reproducible
Failure is discarded
Control result is presented as technical correctness

g23_areas.label: Coverage measurement
g23_areas.purpose: Define denominators, indicators, trend windows and evidence-quality signals for scoped coverage.
g23_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Measures coverage and evidence health; it does not replace the audit ledger or turn a percentage into correctness.
g23_areas.source_gate: Metric definition, population, exclusions, source IDs and observation window are explicit.
g23_areas.licence_gate: Inputs and derived reports respect source, dataset, fixture and output rights.
g23_areas.currentness_gate: Window, retrieval date, effective period and stale-data behavior are explicit.
g23_areas.professional_boundary: Metrics are decision support only; qualified reviewers interpret consequential results.
blocked_when: Denominator or exclusions are undefined
Metric inputs are not traceable
A percentage is used as a correctness or compliance claim

g23_areas.label: Incident and nonconformance
g23_areas.purpose: Record deviations, failed gates, recurrence, corrective action and closure evidence.
g23_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Handles observed nonconformance and remediation; it does not waive or approve G22 exceptions.
g23_areas.source_gate: Incident record preserves trigger, evidence, impact, containment, corrective action and verification.
g23_areas.licence_gate: Incident artifacts, logs, fixtures and derivatives retain their use and disclosure decisions.
g23_areas.currentness_gate: Incident time, affected version, jurisdiction and active or revoked status are retained.
g23_areas.professional_boundary: Material technical, legal, financial, safety or professional incidents escalate to the appropriate role.
blocked_when: Impact or containment is unknown
Corrective action lacks owner or verification
Recurrence or escalation status is unresolved

g23_areas.label: Dependency impact
g23_areas.purpose: Trace how source, tool, licence, version, skill-owner or role changes propagate across scoped routes.
g23_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Performs impact analysis over dependencies; it does not replace G22 change control or ownership review.
g23_areas.source_gate: Dependency edge, affected artifact, evidence snapshot and impact decision are traceable.
g23_areas.licence_gate: Upstream and downstream source, tool, plug-in and derivative rights are rechecked after impact.
g23_areas.currentness_gate: Version, effective date, jurisdiction and end-of-support or refresh signals are recorded.
g23_areas.professional_boundary: Subject-matter owners review consequential impacts; graph presence is not design or compliance approval.
blocked_when: Dependency edge or affected route is unknown
Impact analysis is incomplete
Owner or professional review is missing

g23_areas.label: Bounded attestation
g23_areas.purpose: Record what a scoped evidence packet supports, what remains unknown and who accepted that bounded statement.
g23_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Binds a claim to evidence and limitations; it does not create certification, professional sign-off or global readiness.
g23_areas.source_gate: Attestation cites the exact evidence snapshot, source status, limitations and residual unknowns.
g23_areas.licence_gate: Attestation route and any publication, training or use disposition have explicit rights decisions.
g23_areas.currentness_gate: Attestation carries observation date, validity horizon, jurisdiction and revalidation trigger.
g23_areas.professional_boundary: Acceptance is role- and scope-bound; it cannot certify, file, send, pay, sign, publish, execute or replace professional approval.
blocked_when: Evidence snapshot or limitations are missing
Residual unknowns are hidden
Acceptance is treated as certification or professional sign-off

state_definitions.existing: A local contract, source register, matrix, gate or prior coordination artifact exists; this is not implementation or correctness proof.
state_definitions.planned: Required assurance packet, metric, exercise, review or decision is specified but not established as complete.
state_definitions.blocked: At least one source, licence, currentness, runtime, incident, dependency or professional gate is open.
state_definitions.verified_structural: Only a named local artifact, field, path or deterministic document check was observed; this is not semantic, factual, legal, licence, runtime, financial or professional verification.

rows.missing_gate: No complete executed-control sample, retained failure or effectiveness conclusion is evidenced.
No approved denominator, metric run, trend baseline or quality interpretation is evidenced.
No incident register, corrective-action evidence or recurrence check is evidenced.
No completed propagation exercise across a scoped route is evidenced.
No evidence-linked attestation with residual unknowns and acceptance record is evidenced.

g23_release_criteria.label: Frozen assurance scope
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Route, canonical owner, applicable G22 controls and G23 assurance scope are fixed.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Technical, legal, financial, safety or professional correctness.

g23_release_criteria.label: Exercised controls
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Each applicable G22 control has a reproducible positive or negative result with retained inputs, environment and output.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That the underlying facet is correct or professionally fit.

g23_release_criteria.label: Defined coverage measurement
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Metrics identify population, denominator, exclusions, time window, source evidence and interpretation limits.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a coverage percentage is a quality, compliance or correctness certificate.

g23_release_criteria.label: Incident and nonconformance control
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Deviations have containment, owner, corrective action, verification, recurrence status and escalation where required.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That an unresolved deviation is harmless or waived.

g23_release_criteria.label: Dependency impact review
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Changed sources, tools, licences, versions, owners, roles and currentness conditions have scoped impact decisions.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a dependency graph proves design adequacy or legal compliance.

g23_release_criteria.label: Source, licence and currentness gates
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Source provenance, rights, validity horizon, jurisdiction and revalidation behavior are explicit and reviewable.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a source is authoritative, current or cleared for every use.

g23_release_criteria.label: Professional boundary review
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Qualified, role-specific review covers the exact evidence version, scope, limitations and date.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Approval outside the reviewed artifact, role or jurisdiction.

g23_release_criteria.label: Bounded attestation
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: An evidence-linked acceptance record states support, limitations, residual unknowns, validity horizon and reviewer.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Certification, professional sign-off or global readiness.

g23_release_criteria.label: Scoped monitored release
g23_release_criteria.pass_when: Release is scoped, reversible and monitored under G22 refresh/rollback controls and authorizes no automatic external action.
g23_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Filing, sending, payment, publication, certification, signing, execution or technical correctness.

g24_areas.label: Control-objective alignment
g24_areas.purpose: Map a scoped objective to applicable G22 controls, G23 assurance checks, evidence and release decisions.
g24_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Tests control-system alignment; it does not create a new control, metric or domain owner.
g24_areas.source_gate: Objective, scope, canonical owner, evidence references and exclusions are explicit.
g24_areas.licence_gate: Objective route, inputs, fixtures and outputs have intended-use and derivative-right decisions.
g24_areas.currentness_gate: Objective period, jurisdiction, version and review horizon are recorded where material.
g24_areas.professional_boundary: Alignment is governance review, not technical, legal, financial, safety or professional approval.
g24_areas.runtime_gate: Mapping is replayed against the current route and detects missing or contradictory controls.
blocked_when: Objective or scope is ambiguous
Control mapping has unexplained gaps or contradictions
Alignment is presented as domain correctness

g24_areas.label: Evidence-integrity chain
g24_areas.purpose: Verify identity, custody, transformation history, checksums and linkage across an evidence packet.
g24_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Tests integrity of the evidence chain; it does not replace G22 audit records or establish substantive truth.
g24_areas.source_gate: Every transformation links input, operation, output, checksum or equivalent integrity marker and observer.
g24_areas.licence_gate: Copying, transformation, storage, log and output rights are recorded; restricted evidence remains restricted.
g24_areas.currentness_gate: Observation time, source version, validity horizon and invalidation trigger are preserved.
g24_areas.professional_boundary: Integrity is not correctness; the qualified reviewer assesses content and intended use.
g24_areas.runtime_gate: The chain is reconstructed from retained artifacts and fails closed on missing or mismatched links.
blocked_when: Artifact identity or transformation is untraceable
Checksum or equivalent integrity check mismatches
Integrity is presented as factual or technical correctness

g24_areas.label: Reproducibility and portability
g24_areas.purpose: Re-run scoped controls and evidence checks across pinned environments, versions and permitted operating contexts.
g24_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Tests repeatability and portability; it does not replace route-specific runtime tests or professional review.
g24_areas.source_gate: Fixture, source snapshot, command, environment, expected result and variance policy are recorded.
g24_areas.licence_gate: Environments, dependencies, fixtures and generated outputs are cleared for the repeat route.
g24_areas.currentness_gate: Rerun date, tool/version, jurisdiction and stale-source behavior are recorded.
g24_areas.professional_boundary: Repeatability does not prove design adequacy, legal validity, financial correctness or conformity.
g24_areas.runtime_gate: Positive, negative and controlled-variance runs are reproducible; unexplained variance blocks.
blocked_when: Environment or dependency cannot be recreated
Variance is unexplained or output is non-deterministic
Repeatability is used as professional approval

g24_areas.label: Continuity and recovery
g24_areas.purpose: Exercise continuity, checkpoint restoration and controlled recovery when a source, tool, dependency or reviewer path is unavailable.
g24_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Tests operational resilience; it does not replace G22 release rollback, revocation or exception authority.
g24_areas.source_gate: Recovery target, dependency assumptions, checkpoint evidence and recovery decision are traceable.
g24_areas.licence_gate: Backup, checkpoint, tool, plug-in, asset and restored output rights are verified for recovery.
g24_areas.currentness_gate: Recovery uses the correct source/version and records outage time, validity and revalidation needs.
g24_areas.professional_boundary: Recovery is not permission to issue a professional deliverable without the required reviewer.
g24_areas.runtime_gate: Failure injection, restore, integrity check and safe-stop behavior are recorded; automatic external action is forbidden.
blocked_when: Recovery target or checkpoint is missing
Restore or integrity check is untested
Recovery bypasses human escalation or professional review

g24_areas.label: Feedback and adaptation
g24_areas.purpose: Convert measured results, incidents, reviews and residual unknowns into controlled improvement priorities.
g24_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs learning from evidence; it does not close incidents, approve changes or alter releases automatically.
g24_areas.source_gate: Feedback links to metric, incident, review, source and affected decision with rationale.
g24_areas.licence_gate: Feedback data and derived recommendations respect source, disclosure, training and derivative rights.
g24_areas.currentness_gate: Trend window, observation date, effective context and revalidation trigger are explicit.
g24_areas.professional_boundary: Improvement priority is not a professional conclusion; qualified owners decide consequential changes.
g24_areas.runtime_gate: Feedback replay demonstrates that a recommendation is traceable and cannot silently change runtime behavior.
blocked_when: Feedback source or rationale is missing
Recommendation changes behavior without review
Trend or currentness context is stale or ambiguous

state_definitions.existing: A local contract, source register, matrix, gate or prior coordination artifact exists; this is not implementation or correctness proof.
state_definitions.planned: Required operational packet, exercise, review or decision is specified but not established as complete.
state_definitions.blocked: At least one source, licence, currentness, runtime, continuity or professional gate is open.
state_definitions.verified_structural: Only a named local artifact, field, path or deterministic document check was observed; this is not semantic, factual, legal, licence, runtime, financial or professional verification.

rows.missing_gate: No complete objective-to-control map with exclusions and contradiction review is evidenced.
No reconstructed end-to-end chain with mismatch and missing-link failures is evidenced.
No cross-environment rerun packet with explained variance is evidenced.
No failure-injection, checkpoint-restore and safe-stop exercise is evidenced.
No closed feedback loop with controlled recommendation replay is evidenced.

g24_release_criteria.label: Frozen objective and route
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Objective, route, canonical owner, applicable G22 controls and G23 assurance scope are fixed and non-contradictory.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Technical, legal, financial, safety or professional correctness.

g24_release_criteria.label: Reconstructed evidence integrity
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Evidence identity and transformation chain reconstruct without unexplained gaps, mismatches or unowned artifacts.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That the evidence is factually correct or substantively sufficient.

g24_release_criteria.label: Source, licence and derivative rights
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Rights decisions cover the full release, recovery, replay and feedback route.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a URL, manifest, checksum or local notice is blanket clearance.

g24_release_criteria.label: Currentness and validity horizon
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Currentness, jurisdiction, validity horizon, invalidation and revalidation triggers are explicit for material claims and dependencies.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That the route is current legal advice or a professional conclusion.

g24_release_criteria.label: Runtime replay and variance
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Positive, negative and controlled-variance cases replay with reproducible outputs; unexplained variance blocks.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Production safety, design adequacy, financial correctness or professional conformity.

g24_release_criteria.label: Continuity and recovery
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Declared checkpoint, restore, integrity check, safe-stop and human-escalation paths are exercised where applicable.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That recovery authorizes external action or professional delivery.

g24_release_criteria.label: Feedback boundedness
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Metrics, incidents, reviews and residual unknowns produce traceable, role-reviewed recommendations that cannot silently alter runtime behavior.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a recommendation is a professional or technical decision.

g24_release_criteria.label: Professional boundary review
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Qualified, role-specific review covers exact evidence version, intended use, limitations, residual unknowns and date.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Approval outside the reviewed artifact, role or jurisdiction.

g24_release_criteria.label: Reversible monitored release
g24_release_criteria.pass_when: Release is scoped, reversible, monitored and revocable under G22/G23 controls, with a tested recovery path and no automatic external action.
g24_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Filing, sending, payment, publication, certification, signing, execution or technical correctness.

g25_areas.label: Claim-scope management
g25_areas.purpose: Define claim types, audience, intended use, exclusions, limitations and residual unknowns for a scoped route.
g25_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs claim scope and drift; it does not replace G23 bounded attestation or make a claim true.
g25_areas.source_gate: Claim links to canonical owner, source packet, evidence snapshot, audience and exact support.
g25_areas.licence_gate: Intended publication, training, internal-use and derivative routes have separate rights decisions.
g25_areas.currentness_gate: Claim date, validity horizon, jurisdiction, version and revalidation trigger are explicit.
g25_areas.professional_boundary: Scope record cannot be legal, technical, financial, safety or professional approval.
g25_areas.runtime_gate: Scope is replayed against the route and fails closed when evidence or audience exceeds the declared boundary.
blocked_when: Claim exceeds the evidence scope
Audience or intended use is undefined
Scope replay does not fail closed

g25_areas.label: Invariant consistency
g25_areas.purpose: Check that source, licence, currentness, runtime, professional and release states do not contradict one another.
g25_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Checks cross-stage invariants; it does not define the underlying controls or substitute for their evidence.
g25_areas.source_gate: Each invariant points to exact records and resolves source, interpretation, example and hypothesis status.
g25_areas.licence_gate: No invariant marks a route pass when an applicable source or derivative right is unknown.
g25_areas.currentness_gate: Currentness status, effective date, jurisdiction and refresh state agree across records.
g25_areas.professional_boundary: A consistent record set is not professional correctness or sign-off.
g25_areas.runtime_gate: Invariant checks run on representative positive and negative packets and stop on contradictions.
blocked_when: Cross-stage records contradict
Invariant or contradiction case is untested
A consistent packet is presented as correctness

g25_areas.label: Independent challenge review
g25_areas.purpose: Provide a second-line challenge of scope, evidence, gates, exceptions and release rationale before disposition.
g25_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Challenges decisions without becoming the domain reviewer, release approver or incident owner.
g25_areas.source_gate: Challenger receives the exact evidence snapshot and records objections, tests and resolution.
g25_areas.licence_gate: Challenger verifies that rights decisions are in scope but does not grant rights beyond authority.
g25_areas.currentness_gate: Challenger checks observation date, version, jurisdiction and staleness handling.
g25_areas.professional_boundary: Independence, qualification, role separation and unresolved objections are explicit; challenge is not certification.
g25_areas.runtime_gate: Challenge can reproduce the relevant check or retain a failed reproduction; unresolved variance blocks.
blocked_when: Challenger is not independent or qualified
Objection or reproduction is not retained
Residual objection is silently treated as resolved

g25_areas.label: Retention and disposition
g25_areas.purpose: Set retention, access, legal-hold, archive, revocation and disposal rules for evidence and derived artifacts.
g25_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs evidence lifecycle after capture; it does not replace integrity, backup/recovery or source provenance.
g25_areas.source_gate: Retention class links to source, artifact type, decision, access record and disposition event.
g25_areas.licence_gate: Retention, copying, archive, deletion and derivative storage respect licence, confidentiality and disclosure terms.
g25_areas.currentness_gate: Retention clock, effective period, stale/revoked status and revalidation or disposal trigger are recorded.
g25_areas.professional_boundary: Retention policy does not authorize use of an artifact for professional work or override a required reviewer.
g25_areas.runtime_gate: Archive, restore and disposal tests prove access control and safe-stop behavior without automatic external action.
blocked_when: Retention or access class is undefined
Legal hold or revocation behavior is untested
Disposal removes required evidence without recorded decision

g25_areas.label: Release communication traceability
g25_areas.purpose: Record who receives a scoped release, its limitations, changes, blockers, revocation and required human actions.
g25_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Communicates an approved disposition; it does not approve, publish globally or replace G24 monitoring or feedback.
g25_areas.source_gate: Message or notice links to release record, evidence snapshot, audience, version and limitations.
g25_areas.licence_gate: Distribution channel, attachments, excerpts and derivatives have explicit rights and disclosure decisions.
g25_areas.currentness_gate: Notice carries release date, validity horizon, jurisdiction, change or revocation trigger and refresh owner.
g25_areas.professional_boundary: Communication cannot be filing, certification, legal advice or professional direction without the qualified role.
g25_areas.runtime_gate: Delivery, acknowledgement, revocation and safe-stop behavior are tested in the target environment; sending remains human-controlled.
blocked_when: Audience or channel is unbounded
Limitations or revocation path is not communicated
Delivery test implies automatic sending or professional direction

state_definitions.verified_structural: Only a named local artifact, field, path or deterministic document check was observed; this is not semantic, factual, legal, licence, runtime, financial or professional verification.

g25_release_criteria.label: Cross-stage invariant consistency

g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a consistent record set is substantively correct.

g25_release_criteria.label: Traceable evidence and disposition

g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That retention or integrity proves truth or authorizes professional use.

g25_release_criteria.label: Independent challenge

g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Certification, domain sign-off or automatic release approval.

g25_release_criteria.label: Retention and revocation behavior
g25_release_criteria.pass_when: Retention, archive, legal-hold, revocation and disposal behavior is explicit and exercised where applicable.
g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That an artifact may be used beyond its rights, validity or professional scope.

g25_release_criteria.label: Release communication
g25_release_criteria.pass_when: Audience, channel, version, limitations, blockers and required human actions are recorded; delivery is not implied by document generation.
g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Filing, sending, publication, legal advice or professional direction.

g25_release_criteria.label: Source, licence and currentness gates
g25_release_criteria.pass_when: Current source provenance, rights, validity horizon, jurisdiction, retention and communication-revocation triggers are explicit.
g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a source is authoritative, current or cleared for every use.

g25_release_criteria.label: Professional boundary review
g25_release_criteria.pass_when: Qualified, role-specific review covers exact artifact, scope, limitations, intended use, residual unknowns and date, with no self-review bypass.
g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Approval outside the reviewed artifact, role or jurisdiction.

g25_release_criteria.label: Reversible human-controlled release
g25_release_criteria.pass_when: Release is scoped, reversible, revocable and human-controlled, with runtime evidence and no automatic external action.
g25_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Payment, certification, signing, execution, professional approval or technical correctness.

g26_areas.label: Ownership and accountability
g26_areas.purpose: Assign accountable owners for obligations, decisions, blockers, exceptions, reviews and follow-up across the scoped route.
g26_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Maintains ongoing accountability; it does not replace G22 role separation, G25 challenge or domain ownership.
g26_areas.source_gate: Owner assignment links to scope, source packet, decision, obligation and escalation evidence.
g26_areas.licence_gate: Accountable owner may not infer rights; each use and derivative decision remains explicit.
g26_areas.currentness_gate: Ownership start/end, version, jurisdiction and handover or review dates are recorded.
g26_areas.professional_boundary: Qualified role and authority are distinct from administrative ownership; no owner self-signs professional acceptance.
g26_areas.runtime_gate: Ownership and escalation paths are exercised with positive, unavailable-owner and handover cases.
blocked_when: Obligation or accountable owner is missing
Handover or escalation is untested
Administrative ownership is presented as professional authority

g26_areas.label: Policy versioning
g26_areas.purpose: Keep governance policies, gate definitions, templates and release contracts compatible across versions.
g26_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Manages policy compatibility; it does not replace G22 change control or G25 invariant checks.
g26_areas.source_gate: Policy change links to affected source, control, evidence, decision and migration record.
g26_areas.licence_gate: Policy templates, examples, fixtures and derived guidance carry their own rights decisions.
g26_areas.currentness_gate: Effective date, superseded version, jurisdiction, sunset and migration window are explicit.
g26_areas.professional_boundary: Policy compatibility is not technical, legal or professional approval of governed content.
g26_areas.runtime_gate: Version negotiation, upgrade, downgrade and incompatible-policy failures are tested and retained.
blocked_when: Policy version or compatibility is undefined
Migration is not reproducible
Incompatible policy is allowed to pass silently

g26_areas.label: Access segmentation
g26_areas.purpose: Limit evidence, review, release and communication access by role, purpose, sensitivity and least privilege.
g26_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs access paths; it does not replace G25 retention/disposition or professional review.
g26_areas.source_gate: Access grant links to artifact, purpose, source status, reviewer role and audit record.
g26_areas.licence_gate: Access, copy, export, disclosure and derivative permissions are checked per asset.
g26_areas.currentness_gate: Access validity, review date, revocation trigger and jurisdictional restrictions are recorded.
g26_areas.professional_boundary: Access is not authorization to conclude, certify, publish or perform professional work.
g26_areas.runtime_gate: Grant, deny, revoke, break-glass and safe-stop behavior are tested without automatic external action.
blocked_when: Role or purpose is over-broad
Revoke or break-glass behavior is untested
Access is treated as approval or publication authority

g26_areas.label: Audit readiness
g26_areas.purpose: Prepare a bounded, retrievable packet showing scope, evidence, gates, decisions, exceptions and limitations for an authorized review.
g26_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Prepares evidence for review; it does not conduct an audit, issue assurance or replace independent challenge.
g26_areas.source_gate: Packet index, locators, versions, checksums, negative cases and decision trail are complete.
g26_areas.licence_gate: Packet assembly, redaction, export and reviewer access respect licence, confidentiality and disclosure terms.
g26_areas.currentness_gate: Packet snapshot, validity horizon, jurisdiction, refresh status and superseded records are identified.
g26_areas.professional_boundary: Audit readiness is not a professional attestation; the authorized reviewer decides within scope.
g26_areas.runtime_gate: Packet build, retrieval, redaction and integrity verification are reproducible; missing evidence blocks.
blocked_when: Packet index or negative cases are incomplete
Redaction or access controls are untested
Readiness is presented as an audit conclusion

g26_areas.label: Exit and decommission
g26_areas.purpose: Retire a scoped route, dependency, policy, communication and runtime safely when superseded, revoked or unsupported.
g26_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs route closure; it does not duplicate G25 retention/disposition or G24 recovery.
g26_areas.source_gate: Exit decision links to affected sources, evidence, open obligations, users, dependencies and closure evidence.
g26_areas.licence_gate: Revocation, archive, deletion, export and derivative handling follow each applicable right and disclosure decision.
g26_areas.currentness_gate: Sunset date, superseding version, jurisdiction, stale/revoked state and reactivation conditions are explicit.
g26_areas.professional_boundary: Decommissioning cannot withdraw required professional records or imply that closure resolves prior professional risk.
g26_areas.runtime_gate: Disable, revoke, archive-check, restore-check and safe-stop behavior are tested; no automatic external action.
blocked_when: Open obligations or affected dependencies are unknown
Disable or revocation is untested
Closure destroys required records or is presented as risk resolution

state_definitions.verified_structural: Only a named local artifact, field, path or deterministic document check was observed; this is not semantic, factual, legal, licence, runtime, financial or professional verification.

g26_release_criteria.label: Compatible policy versions

g26_release_criteria.label: Segmented access

g26_release_criteria.label: Bounded audit packet

g26_release_criteria.label: Exit and decommission readiness

g26_release_criteria.label: Runtime evidence

g27_areas.label: Control-performance thresholds
g27_areas.purpose: Define bounded indicators, action thresholds, alert semantics and escalation without turning measurements into correctness claims.
g27_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Adds decision thresholds over G23 metrics; it does not replace coverage measurement, risk classification or domain acceptance.

g27_areas.licence_gate: Threshold inputs, fixtures, reports and derived alerts have explicit use and derivative-right decisions.
g27_areas.currentness_gate: Observation window, effective date, refresh period, jurisdiction and threshold review date are explicit.
g27_areas.professional_boundary: Threshold breach triggers review; it is not technical, legal, financial, safety or professional judgment.
g27_areas.runtime_gate: Threshold and alert behavior are replayed on positive, boundary, negative and missing-data cases; ambiguity fails closed.

Boundary or missing-data replay is absent
Alert result is presented as correctness

g27_areas.label: Conflict resolution
g27_areas.purpose: Resolve conflicting source, gate, role, currentness, licence or release records with precedence, escalation and residual uncertainty.
g27_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Resolves conflicts between records; it does not replace G25 invariants or invent missing evidence.
g27_areas.source_gate: Each conflict links to exact records, source status, contradiction, precedence rule and decision rationale.
g27_areas.licence_gate: Conflicting rights claims remain blocked until an authorized rights decision resolves them.
g27_areas.currentness_gate: Effective dates, jurisdiction, supersession, retrieval time and conflict horizon are recorded.
g27_areas.professional_boundary: Resolution role, authority, independence and limitations are explicit; resolution is not professional correctness.
g27_areas.runtime_gate: Conflict fixtures exercise precedence, tie, stale-record and no-resolution paths; unresolved cases stop.

Conflict path is untested
Unresolved conflict is silently treated as resolved

g27_areas.label: Third-party boundary
g27_areas.purpose: Define evidence, responsibility, service, tool and dependency boundaries when an external party or supplied artifact affects the route.
g27_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Delimits responsibility and reliance; it does not replace dependency impact, licence review or professional ownership.
g27_areas.source_gate: Third-party identity, supplied evidence, scope, responsibility, assumptions, contact and exit condition are recorded.
g27_areas.licence_gate: Contract, source, tool, service, asset, output and derivative rights are checked separately.
g27_areas.currentness_gate: Third-party version, service date, jurisdiction, support window and revalidation trigger are explicit.
g27_areas.professional_boundary: External input does not transfer professional duty; qualified owners review consequential reliance.
g27_areas.runtime_gate: Substitution, outage, timeout, degraded and supplied-artifact validation cases are exercised without automatic external action.
blocked_when: Third-party responsibility or assumption is unbounded
Substitution or outage behavior is untested
External input is treated as professional approval

g27_areas.label: Assurance sampling
g27_areas.purpose: Select representative, boundary, negative and high-risk cases for repeatable assurance review.
g27_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs sample design and sufficiency evidence; it does not conduct the audit or make sampled content correct.
g27_areas.source_gate: Sampling frame, population, exclusions, selection method, seed and source/evidence links are retained.
g27_areas.licence_gate: Sampled artifacts, fixtures, outputs and excerpts have rights and disclosure decisions.
g27_areas.currentness_gate: Sampling period, version, jurisdiction, freshness and resampling trigger are recorded.
g27_areas.professional_boundary: Qualified reviewer sets or approves material sampling scope; sample result is not professional sign-off.
g27_areas.runtime_gate: Selection and replay use a retained seed and reproduce the same cases; missing population data blocks.
blocked_when: Population or selection method is incomplete
Seeded replay is not reproducible
Sample result is presented as universal correctness

g27_areas.label: Transparency reporting
g27_areas.purpose: Produce bounded status reports showing coverage, blockers, limitations, confidence boundaries and change history to an authorized audience.
g27_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Aggregates governance status; it does not replace release communication, audit packet, attestation or professional advice.

g27_areas.licence_gate: Report, chart, attachment, excerpt and distribution route have explicit rights and disclosure decisions.
g27_areas.currentness_gate: Report date, validity horizon, jurisdiction, superseded status and refresh owner are visible.
g27_areas.professional_boundary: Transparency report states its limits and cannot certify, file, publish as authority or direct professional action.
g27_areas.runtime_gate: Report generation, redaction, distribution preview and stale-data warning are reproducible; sending remains human-controlled.
blocked_when: Report values or blockers are not traceable
Stale or superseded state is hidden
Report implies authority or automatic publication

research.meaning: Source material, observations, references, interpretations, examples or hypotheses retained for investigation.
research.does_not_mean: Verified answer, advice, design, estimate, filing, certification or official act.

draft.meaning: A proposed or generated artifact prepared for review, revision or internal coordination.
draft.does_not_mean: Signed, protocoled, filed, issued, certified, legally effective or professionally approved artifact.

official_act.meaning: An act recognized only through the competent external or organizational authority and its required process.
official_act.does_not_mean: A status inferred from filename, format, release, hash, publication, model output or repository commit.
official_act.local_roadmap_boundary: This repository cannot create, simulate, sign, protocol, file, issue, certify or revoke an official act.

g28_state_separation.coordination_release_status: The G28 roadmap/decision-log release is documentation only; it is neither a draft official act nor an official act.

g28_areas.label: Research classification
g28_areas.purpose: Classify research evidence, observations, interpretations, examples and hypotheses before reuse.
g28_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs research labeling; it does not turn source presence into truth or replace G27 source and provenance gates.
g28_areas.source_gate: Item has source locator, source type, observer, context, version/date and explicit interpretation boundary.
g28_areas.licence_gate: Research source, copy, excerpt and derivative use are recorded separately from later draft or official use.
g28_areas.currentness_gate: Retrieval/observation time, effective period, jurisdiction and staleness status are explicit.
g28_areas.professional_boundary: Research classification is not technical, legal, financial, safety or professional advice.
g28_areas.runtime_gate: Classification and blocked-use behavior replay on source, interpretation, hypothesis and unknown cases.
blocked_when: Source type or interpretation boundary is missing
Staleness or rights context is unknown
Research is used as an official or professional result

g28_areas.label: Draft lifecycle control
g28_areas.purpose: Control creation, revision, review, watermark/status, versioning and withdrawal of proposed drafts.
g28_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs draft state; it does not replace G26 policy versioning, G27 release communication or official authority.
g28_areas.source_gate: Draft links to research inputs, evidence snapshot, author, reviewers, version and change rationale.
g28_areas.licence_gate: Draft content, template, assets, excerpts and derivatives have intended-use rights before circulation.
g28_areas.currentness_gate: Draft date, validity horizon, jurisdiction, superseded status and review deadline are visible.
g28_areas.professional_boundary: Draft review is not sign-off, certification, legal advice or professional approval.
g28_areas.runtime_gate: Create, revise, compare, withdraw and block official-use actions on drafts are tested.
blocked_when: Draft status or version is ambiguous
Withdrawal or official-use block is untested
Draft is circulated as signed or final

g28_areas.label: Official-act authority gate
g28_areas.purpose: Record authority, role, required signature/protocol/filing process and evidence needed before an act can be recognized as official.
g28_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Defines the boundary to official status; it does not issue, sign, file, certify or simulate an act.
g28_areas.source_gate: Authority, source basis, exact version, decision record and required external process are identified.
g28_areas.licence_gate: Official-use, publication, record and derivative rights are assessed separately from research and draft rights.
g28_areas.currentness_gate: Effective date, jurisdiction, legal/procedural validity window and revocation route are explicit.
g28_areas.professional_boundary: Competent professional, legal or organizational authority must act within scope; no repository status substitutes for it.
g28_areas.runtime_gate: Authority gate fails closed without required human action, signature, protocol or filing evidence.
blocked_when: Authority or required process is missing
Signature/protocol/filing evidence is absent
Draft or repository status is treated as official

g28_areas.label: State-transition reconciliation
g28_areas.purpose: Reconcile research inputs, draft revisions and any externally supplied official-act record without collapsing their identities.
g28_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Checks transitions and identity; it does not authorize a transition or overwrite an official record.
g28_areas.source_gate: Each state has distinct identifier, evidence snapshot, version, predecessor/successor and transition decision.
g28_areas.licence_gate: Transition, export, archive, redaction and official-record references retain per-state rights decisions.
g28_areas.currentness_gate: Transition time, effective date, jurisdiction, supersession and withdrawal status agree across records.
g28_areas.professional_boundary: Reconciliation confirms records correspond; it is not substantive or professional correctness.
g28_areas.runtime_gate: Mismatch, missing predecessor, duplicate identity or unauthorized transition blocks and is retained.
blocked_when: State identity or predecessor is missing
Transition is unauthorized or non-reproducible
Reconciliation is used to infer official status

g28_areas.label: Publication and protocol boundary
g28_areas.purpose: Separate internal circulation, draft publication, official publication, protocol, filing and public-record actions.
g28_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Defines channel and act boundaries; it does not replace G27 reporting, G26 access or external publication authority.
g28_areas.source_gate: Channel, audience, artifact state, evidence snapshot, publication decision and official-record reference are linked.
g28_areas.licence_gate: Channel, attachment, excerpt, translation, publication and public-record rights are explicit.
g28_areas.currentness_gate: Publication date, jurisdiction, validity, superseded/revoked state and correction route are recorded.
g28_areas.professional_boundary: Publication or protocol is not authorized by a document generator; required qualified authority remains separate.
g28_areas.runtime_gate: Preview, redaction, acknowledgement, protocol-reference and revocation checks are tested; sending remains human-controlled.
blocked_when: Artifact state or audience is unbounded
Protocol or filing is inferred from publication
Revocation or correction path is untested

state_definitions.planned: Required state-boundary packet, transition, authority, publication or review is specified but not established as complete.

state_definitions.verified_structural: Only a named local artifact, field, path or deterministic document check was observed; this is not semantic, factual, legal, licence, runtime, financial, official or professional verification.

g29_release_criteria.label: Runtime and professional boundary gates
g29_release_criteria.pass_when: Arithmetic/reconciliation, citation/conflict, form/status, mixed-routing and escalation/safe-stop tests have retained results where applicable, with qualified review.
g29_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Technical correctness, professional sign-off, official status or external acceptance.

g29_release_criteria.label: High-risk disposition
g29_release_criteria.pass_when: High-risk, stale, unsupported or consequential claims route to blocked, refusal, research-only, draft or qualified review with residual unknowns.
g29_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That escalation or refusal establishes a positive claim.

g29_release_criteria.label: Reversible non-authoritative release
g29_release_criteria.pass_when: Release is scoped, reversible, revocable and human-controlled, and creates no official act, legal effect, financial entitlement, administrative acceptance or automatic external action.
g29_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Payment, certification, signing, execution, professional approval, legal effect or technical correctness.

pratica.meaning: Research or draft package prepared for a procedure.
pratica.required_authority: Competent authority for the applicable procedure.
pratica.required_professional: Qualified professional where the process or technical content requires one.

deposito.meaning: Draft submission package prepared for the responsible channel.
deposito.does_not_mean: Protocol receipt, deposited record or evidence of acceptance.
deposito.required_authority: Responsible authority and its designated submission channel.
deposito.required_professional: Qualified professional where preparation, signature or technical responsibility is required.

scia.meaning: Research, checklist, field mapping or draft SCIA-related material.
scia.does_not_mean: A declaration with established effect, verified compliance or authority acceptance.
scia.required_professional: Qualified professional for any required technical assertion, declaration or review.

autorizzazione.meaning: Request, prerequisite package or draft decision for an authorization pathway.
autorizzazione.does_not_mean: Authorization, permit, clearance or official act.
autorizzazione.required_professional: Qualified professional where the applicable process requires technical or professional responsibility.

competent_handoff.meaning: Bounded request for review or action by a competent professional or authority.
competent_handoff.does_not_mean: Signature, certification, filing, protocol, issuance or professional sign-off.
competent_handoff.required_authority: The named competent authority where an official process is involved.
competent_handoff.required_professional: The named qualified professional within scope where professional review is required.

g30_authority_boundary.global_boundary: Preparation, checklist, template, draft, preview, hash, commit or generated file cannot establish official status, legal effect, authority acceptance or professional correctness.

g30_areas.label: Pratiche boundary
g30_areas.purpose: Bound a pratica or dossier to authority, procedure, required evidence, state and competent review without asserting submission or acceptance.
g30_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Operationalizes G29 administrative limits for practices; it does not issue, file, approve or certify a practice.
g30_areas.source_gate: Authority, procedure, form/version, property or project context, required evidence and status are source-linked.
g30_areas.licence_gate: Forms, plans, attachments, templates, extracts and derivatives have explicit use, disclosure and publication rights.
g30_areas.currentness_gate: Procedure version, territory, effective date, deadline, status and correction or withdrawal route are explicit.
g30_areas.professional_boundary: Qualified professional and competent authority review remain separate; checklist completeness is not conformity.
g30_areas.runtime_gate: Field validation, missing-document, version, rejection and no-authority paths are reproducible; sending remains human-controlled.
blocked_when: Authority or procedure is missing
Required evidence or status is unresolved
Dossier is presented as submitted, accepted or approved

g30_areas.label: Depositi boundary
g30_areas.purpose: Bound a deposito package to its responsible authority, submission channel, protocol evidence and status without inferring deposit or acceptance.
g30_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Operationalizes the deposit path; it does not create a protocol receipt, deposited record or official filing.
g30_areas.source_gate: Depositor/authority, package version, required contents, channel, submission attempt and official reference if supplied are linked.
g30_areas.licence_gate: Package, drawings, forms, attachments, portal content and archive/export rights are recorded separately.
g30_areas.currentness_gate: Filing window, jurisdiction, form/version, submission time, status and correction/revocation route are explicit.
g30_areas.professional_boundary: Competent professional prepares or reviews as required; a package is not signed or certified by generation.
g30_areas.runtime_gate: Package build, validation, submission preview, rejection and protocol-reference checks are reproducible; actual sending is human-controlled.
blocked_when: Channel or required contents are missing
Protocol evidence is absent or unverified
Package is presented as filed or accepted

g30_areas.label: SCIA boundary
g30_areas.purpose: Bound SCIA-related research and draft materials to procedure, authority, declarations, evidence, status and professional review without claiming legal effect.
g30_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Applies G29 claim limits to SCIA pathways; it does not determine effect, compliance or acceptance.
g30_areas.source_gate: Procedure, competent authority, declaration fields, attachments, source rules, reviewer and status are identified.
g30_areas.licence_gate: Forms, declarations, technical attachments, portals, translations and derivatives have explicit rights and disclosure decisions.
g30_areas.currentness_gate: Territory, applicable version, submission/status date, deadlines, amendments, withdrawal and revalidation are recorded.
g30_areas.professional_boundary: Qualified professional and competent authority remain responsible for the declaration and required technical assertion.
g30_areas.runtime_gate: Field/schema validation, missing evidence, inconsistent status, no-authority and safe-stop cases are retained; no automatic SCIA transmission.
blocked_when: Procedure or authority is unresolved
Required declaration or technical evidence is missing
SCIA material is presented as effective, compliant or accepted

g30_areas.label: Autorizzazioni boundary
g30_areas.purpose: Bound authorization requests and draft decisions to authority, scope, prerequisites, review and decision status without presenting a request as authorization.
g30_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Separates request, review and decision; it does not grant, simulate or certify an authorization.
g30_areas.source_gate: Authority, legal or procedural basis, scope, prerequisites, evidence, decision version and official reference if supplied are linked.
g30_areas.licence_gate: Application, evidence, plans, reports, decision text, publication and archive rights are checked separately.
g30_areas.currentness_gate: Jurisdiction, effective period, deadline, conditions, supersession, suspension and revocation route are explicit.
g30_areas.professional_boundary: Competent authority and qualified professional review are distinct; a draft decision is not approval.
g30_areas.runtime_gate: Prerequisite, condition, missing-document, refusal, suspension and revocation paths are reproducible; issuance remains human-controlled.
blocked_when: Authority or prerequisites are missing
Decision status or conditions are unresolved
Request or draft decision is presented as authorization

g30_areas.label: Competent professional handoff
g30_areas.purpose: Record the bounded handoff from research or draft preparation to the competent professional or authority with scope, questions, evidence and pending actions.
g30_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Governs handoff and accountability; it does not transfer duty, authorize action or replace professional review.
g30_areas.source_gate: Handoff identifies recipient role/authority, exact artifact, evidence snapshot, questions, assumptions, limitations and response status.
g30_areas.licence_gate: Handoff content, attachments, excerpts and recipient channel have explicit rights and disclosure decisions.
g30_areas.currentness_gate: Handoff date, validity horizon, jurisdiction, deadline, revalidation and superseded status are explicit.
g30_areas.professional_boundary: Competence, independence, scope, decision, signature and date are recorded by the professional or authority, not inferred locally.
g30_areas.runtime_gate: Handoff preview, acknowledgement, clarification, refusal, escalation and safe-stop paths are tested; sending remains human-controlled.
blocked_when: Recipient role or authority is undefined
Handoff response or limitations are missing
Handoff is treated as signature, certification or professional sign-off

state_definitions.existing: A local contract, source register, matrix, gate or prior coordination artifact exists; this is not implementation, authority, acceptance or correctness proof.
state_definitions.planned: Required administrative-pathway, authority, professional-handoff or review packet is specified but not established as complete.
state_definitions.blocked: At least one source, licence, currentness, runtime, authority, administrative or professional gate is open.
state_definitions.verified_structural: Only a named local artifact, field, path or deterministic document check was observed; this is not semantic, factual, legal, licence, runtime, administrative, official or professional verification.

rows.missing_gate: No authority-linked dossier, status, rejection or no-acceptance exercise is evidenced.
No channel validation, submission preview, protocol-reference or rejection exercise is evidenced.
No competent-authority/professional review packet or no-transmission exercise is evidenced.
No authority-linked prerequisite, condition, refusal, suspension or revocation exercise is evidenced.
No bounded handoff, acknowledgement, clarification or refusal packet is evidenced.

g30_release_criteria.label: Explicit pathway classification
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Pathway is classified as pratica, deposito, SCIA, autorizzazione or competent-professional handoff, with state and intended process bounded.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Technical, legal, administrative or professional correctness, effect or acceptance.

g30_release_criteria.label: Competent authority and professional
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Responsible authority, qualified professional, jurisdiction, procedure, role, required action and decision boundary are identified.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That the named party has acted, signed, filed, protocoled, authorized or accepted anything.

g30_release_criteria.label: Source, licence and currentness gates
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Rights, provenance, procedure/version, effective date, deadline, status, conditions, revocation and revalidation cover every form, field, attachment and derivative.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a source, form or procedure is authoritative or sufficient for the actual process.

g30_release_criteria.label: Non-official package boundary
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Prepared package is visibly distinct from submitted, protocoled, effective, accepted, authorized or officially recorded material.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Submission, protocol, legal effect, administrative decision or authority acceptance.

g30_release_criteria.label: Runtime pathway tests
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Validation, missing evidence, rejection/refusal, status changes, suspension/revocation, handoff and safe-stop tests have retained results; sending remains human-controlled.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Operational acceptance, professional conformity or official process completion.

g30_release_criteria.label: Professional review boundary
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Required professional review covers exact artifact, scope, assumptions, limitations, intended process, authority, residual unknowns and date.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Professional sign-off when it is not recorded by the competent professional.

g30_release_criteria.label: SCIA and authorization limits
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: SCIA material, authorization requests and draft decisions state that effect, compliance, authorization and acceptance require the competent process.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: SCIA effect, compliance, permit, authorization, clearance or official act.

g30_release_criteria.label: Handoff, correction and revocation
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Handoff, escalation, clarification, correction, withdrawal and revocation paths are traceable and reversible without inventing acceptance.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a handoff transfers legal, administrative or professional responsibility.

g30_release_criteria.label: Reversible non-official release
g30_release_criteria.pass_when: Release is scoped, reversible and human-controlled, and creates no automatic filing, protocol, payment, publication, certification, signing, authorization, administrative effect or professional approval.
g30_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Technical, legal, administrative or professional correctness, effect, acceptance or official status.

certifications.coordination_meaning: Source-bounded evidence map, checklist, draft certificate fields or review questions.
certifications.explicit_limit: Not a certificate, attestation, conformity declaration, certification decision or professional sign-off.
certifications.required_boundary: Competent certifier and, where applicable, the responsible authority/process.

environmental_assessments.coordination_meaning: Research notes, source-bounded indicators, screening inputs, issue lists or draft assessment structure.
environmental_assessments.explicit_limit: Not an official environmental assessment, approval, permit, compliance conclusion or environmental authorization.
environmental_assessments.required_boundary: Competent environmental professional and responsible authority.

waste.coordination_meaning: Source-bounded inventory, candidate classification, handling/traceability checklist or draft record.
waste.explicit_limit: Not an authoritative waste classification, transport/handling authorization, acceptance, official register or compliance decision.
waste.required_boundary: Competent waste professional/operator and responsible authority.

road_safety.coordination_meaning: Observations, risk hypotheses, inspection prompts, evidence map or draft analysis.
road_safety.explicit_limit: Not an official road-safety assessment, traffic/road authorization, safety clearance, order or compliance sign-off.
road_safety.required_boundary: Competent road-safety professional and responsible road authority.

competent_review.coordination_meaning: Cross-sector routing, review ownership and fail-closed escalation.
competent_review.explicit_limit: A routing package does not transfer duty, sign, certify, file, authorize or establish professional correctness.
competent_review.required_boundary: Named competent professional and/or responsible authority for the exact sector and jurisdiction.

g31_claim_limits.global_boundary: Report, checklist, calculation, preview, hash, commit or draft package cannot create legal effect, professional conformity, authority acceptance or a certification/assessment/authorization status.

g31_areas.label: Certification boundary
g31_areas.purpose: Bound certification-like outputs, attestations and conformity language to source-bounded research or draft review material.
g31_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Specializes the generic G29/G30 boundary around certification status and sign-off; it does not issue or simulate a certification.
g31_areas.source_gate: Every certification-like statement is linked to a local source or marked unresolved; source interpretation is separated from the draft wording.
g31_areas.licence_gate: Certificate forms, marks, templates, extracts, attachments and derivatives have explicit access, reuse and disclosure decisions.
g31_areas.currentness_gate: Applicable scheme/version, jurisdiction, date, validity horizon, supersession and revalidation trigger are recorded.
g31_areas.professional_boundary: Only the competent certifier/process can establish certification, attestation, conformity or sign-off; generated material remains draft.
g31_areas.runtime_gate: Runtime refuses or routes certificate, attestation, conformity and sign-off claims; no automatic signature, issuance or publication.
blocked_when: Source, licence or currentness is unresolved
Competent certifier/process is not identified
Draft is presented as certificate, conformity or sign-off

g31_areas.label: Environmental assessment boundary
g31_areas.purpose: Bound environmental screening, indicators, assessment drafts and approval language without asserting environmental correctness or official effect.
g31_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Specializes G29/G30 claims for environmental assessment and approval; it does not decide an assessment, permit or authorization.
g31_areas.source_gate: Indicators, assumptions, context and unresolved questions are source-linked; no environmental conclusion is inferred from a checklist or draft.
g31_areas.licence_gate: Environmental datasets, maps, reports, forms, excerpts and derivatives have explicit use and publication decisions.
g31_areas.currentness_gate: Dataset/report version, observation or effective date, jurisdiction, validity horizon and re-check trigger are recorded.
g31_areas.professional_boundary: A competent environmental professional and responsible authority remain necessary for any official assessment, approval, permit or compliance conclusion.
g31_areas.runtime_gate: Runtime labels screening as draft and refuses or routes assessment, approval, permit and compliance claims; no automatic filing or authorization.
blocked_when: Environmental source/context or currentness is missing
Professional/authority route is undefined
Draft is presented as official assessment, approval or compliance

g31_areas.label: Waste boundary
g31_areas.purpose: Bound waste inventory, candidate classification, handling, transport and traceability material to research or draft coordination.
g31_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Adds lifecycle and traceability constraints distinct from the general administrative pathway; it does not establish an authoritative waste status or authorization.
g31_areas.source_gate: Material, context, candidate classification, handling assumptions and traceability questions are linked to identified sources or marked unresolved.
g31_areas.licence_gate: Registers, transport records, forms, datasets, extracts and attachments have explicit access, reuse and disclosure decisions.
g31_areas.currentness_gate: Applicable source/version, jurisdiction, date, status, validity horizon, supersession and re-check trigger are recorded.
g31_areas.professional_boundary: Competent waste professional/operator and responsible authority remain necessary for classification, handling, transport, acceptance or authorization decisions.
g31_areas.runtime_gate: Runtime blocks or routes authoritative classification, acceptance, transport/handling authorization and official-record claims; no automatic external action.
blocked_when: Source, licence or currentness is unresolved
Competent waste route is missing
Draft is presented as authoritative classification, acceptance or authorization

g31_areas.label: Road-safety boundary
g31_areas.purpose: Bound road-safety observations, risk hypotheses, inspections and authority-facing drafts without claiming an official safety decision.
g31_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Separates safety observations from official road/traffic decisions, permits and compliance sign-off; it does not certify road safety.
g31_areas.source_gate: Observation, location/context, assumptions, risk hypothesis and unresolved questions are linked to identified sources or marked unresolved.
g31_areas.licence_gate: Maps, imagery, inspection material, reports, forms and derivatives have explicit use, reuse and publication decisions.
g31_areas.currentness_gate: Observation date, map/report/version, jurisdiction, temporary status and re-check trigger are recorded.
g31_areas.professional_boundary: Competent road-safety professional and responsible road authority remain necessary for assessment, clearance, order, authorization or compliance sign-off.
g31_areas.runtime_gate: Runtime distinguishes observation/risk draft from official assessment, clearance, traffic/road authorization and compliance; no automatic authority action.
blocked_when: Location/source/currentness is unresolved
Competent road authority/professional route is missing
Draft is presented as official safety assessment or authorization

g31_areas.label: Competent review escalation
g31_areas.purpose: Route certification, environmental, waste and road-safety outputs to the named competent professional or authority with explicit scope and stop conditions.
g31_areas.non_redundant_boundary: Specializes G30 handoff for the four sectors; it does not replace the existing handoff contract or transfer professional responsibility.
g31_areas.source_gate: Recipient role, exact artifact, source snapshot, questions, assumptions, limitations and pending decision are recorded.
g31_areas.licence_gate: Handoff content, attachments, excerpts and recipient channel have explicit rights and disclosure decisions.
g31_areas.currentness_gate: Handoff date, jurisdiction, validity horizon, deadline, superseded status and revalidation route are explicit.
g31_areas.professional_boundary: Handoff requests review; it does not sign, certify, file, authorize, accept or establish professional correctness.
g31_areas.runtime_gate: Preview, acknowledgement, clarification, refusal, escalation, safe-stop and withdrawal paths are reproducible; sending remains human-controlled.
blocked_when: Recipient role or authority is undefined
Scope, limitations or response status is missing
Handoff is treated as certification, authorization or professional sign-off

state_definitions.existing: A local contract, source register, matrix, gate or prior coordination artifact exists; this is not implementation, authority, acceptance or correctness proof.
state_definitions.planned: The G31 sector-boundary work is specified but not established as complete or authoritative.

g31_release_criteria.label: Five distinct sector-boundary areas
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: All five G31 areas are present with distinct scope and non-redundancy rationale.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Technical, legal, environmental, waste or road-safety correctness.

g31_release_criteria.label: Certification limit
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: Certificate, attestation, conformity and sign-off language is visibly bounded and routed to the competent certifier/process.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Certification, attestation, conformity or professional sign-off.

g31_release_criteria.label: Environmental assessment limit
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: Screening, assessment, approval, permit and compliance language is visibly bounded and routed to competent review.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: An official environmental assessment, approval, permit or compliance conclusion.

g31_release_criteria.label: Waste limit
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: Classification, handling, transport, traceability, acceptance and authorization language is visibly bounded and routed to competent review.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Authoritative waste classification, acceptance, authorization or official record.

g31_release_criteria.label: Road-safety limit
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: Safety assessment, clearance, traffic/road authorization and compliance language is visibly bounded and routed to competent review.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: An official road-safety assessment, clearance, order, authorization or compliance sign-off.

g31_release_criteria.label: Source, licence and currentness gates
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: Every material claim has source, rights and currentness evidence or is explicitly unresolved.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a source is factually correct, sufficient or currently authoritative.

g31_release_criteria.label: Professional boundary and escalation
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: Named competent professional/authority ownership, scope, limitations and escalation path are recorded for each sector.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: That a professional or authority has reviewed, signed, accepted or acted.

g31_release_criteria.label: Runtime negative paths
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: Runtime tests demonstrate refusal/routing of official-sector claims, safe stop and human-controlled handoff; structural checks are reported separately.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Production safety, technical adequacy, legal validity or professional conformity.

g31_release_criteria.label: Reversible non-authoritative release
g31_release_criteria.pass_when: The coordination record or draft package is withdrawable/supersedable, labelled non-authoritative, owner-linked and creates no automatic filing, certification, authorization or external action.
g31_release_criteria.does_not_prove: Technical, legal, environmental, waste or road-safety correctness, effect or acceptance.

global_blockers: G19 reference-library SKILL.md paths are recorded as absent from the inventory checkout.
Generated parsed artifacts described by local README/serializer evidence are absent for IFC, normative and technical-document indexes where noted.
No facet has a completed provenance packet, rights decision, deterministic runtime report and qualified professional sign-off in this decision log.
Static presence, parsing or unit-test success cannot be promoted to production safety, design adequacy, legal validity, financial correctness or professional conformity.

release_gates.label: Canonical mapping and non-redundancy
release_gates.pass_when: One canonical owner and alias resolution are reviewed; no facet creates a duplicate domain skill.
release_gates.does_not_prove: Semantic equivalence, source correctness or content completeness.

release_gates.label: Provenance, context and rights
release_gates.pass_when: Source/interpretation/example/hypothesis, version/effective context, jurisdiction/period, attribution and rights are recorded; otherwise status remains blocked.
release_gates.does_not_prove: That the source is factually correct or currently authoritative.

release_gates.label: Runtime and failure evidence
release_gates.pass_when: The target workflow runs with deterministic fixtures, environment metadata, reproducible outputs and retained negative cases.
release_gates.does_not_prove: Production safety, structural adequacy, legal validity or professional conformity.

release_gates.label: Professional review and release
release_gates.pass_when: The appropriate qualified reviewer records scope, limitations and decision; all open blockers are visible and no automatic external action is implied.
